# Original Memory Inspector implementation

Captured before migrating the existing owner-only inspector to a managed feature plugin. These bytes establish the original navigation, rendering, client behavior and styles. They do not authorize candidate DOM scripts or expose the internal inspection model. Runtime compatibility, if required, must name its actual consumer independently; these sources are test evidence only.

`worker-v1.js.txt` is a reviewed resource snapshot of the unreleased managed Worker, not pre-migration native source. Its byte allowlist is separate from the 106 executed-original client decision cases and captured native labels/visibility. Updating this reviewed snapshot does not update those original semantic oracles.
